description: A workstation seized from a suspected lone-wolf threat actor shows evidence of encrypted communications, extremist research, and planning activity. VeraCrypt containers, Tor Browser usage, and an encrypted USB device indicate deliberate anti-forensic measures. Manifesto drafts were partially recovered from unallocated space. Investigation must establish intent, communication channels, and extent of planning.
investigation_questions: What evidence of planning activity exists?
What encrypted containers or anti-forensic tools were used?
What external communication channels were used?
Is there sufficient evidence of threat intent for legal action?
